dataset: HD-EMG, 13 subjects, 320 channels with paired 21x3 kinematics
selection: Chronological blocks [0,60%), [60%,80%), [80%,100%) per subject/task at 2000 Hz. Skip first 2000 samples of val/test blocks. Enumerate every complete nonoverlapping 6000-sample window in each block. No cross-window state; prefix calibration uses only the first 1000 samples of that window. One-second gaps exceed 40 ms FIR support; full 3 s readout input stays within its block.

timing.labels: At floor(output end sample * 128/125), no label lag fitting or delay compensation.

targets: Stored points 1..20 minus stored point 0, flattened to 60 coordinates. Physical coordinate units and landmark anatomy unverified; report stored coordinate units, not mm or palm lengths.
cache: Per-subject cache: 100 frames ends 2039..5999; uint16 IDs, float16 continuous, float32 normalized raw and targets; fixed 32-channel encoder batch. Frozen original release. Exact matching first windows reused from original training cache after validation.
raw_arm: Same causal readout, channel encoder initialized from scratch at width 64, hidden width 16; no pretrained weights. Different parameter counts are reported.
inputs: All 320 channels and fixed montage; no subject/task IDs, labels, kinematic initialization, or calibration side inputs. All arms share release prefix calibration of their EMG input.

training.loss: Smooth L1 on train-only standardized coordinates, final 50 frames.
training.selection: Lowest validation macro-subject mean 3D point error, earliest epoch on ties.

evaluation: Only after all 81 fits complete. Mean 3D error and coordinate R2 for each of 9 subjects and each seed. Macro-subject error per seed, mean and sample SD over 3 seeds. Subject-specific constant training-mean pose baseline. Windows/time points are not independent participants.
models: A separate decoder per subject, arm and seed; 81 fits total. No sharing of decoder parameters or target statistics across subjects. Same readout/training settings as original pilot.
